Sharpe / Sortino / Calmar by LB
Ratio Definitions
Sharpe Ratio — Annualised return ÷ volatility. >3.0=institutional. Hedge funds target 1.0–2.0.
Sortino Ratio — Penalises only downside. Higher than Sharpe = asymmetric wins.
Calmar Ratio — Annual return% ÷ Max drawdown%. >3.0=strong.
Recovery Factor — Total P&L ÷ Max drawdown. Times you earned back worst period.
Expectancy — Avg $ per trade. Must be positive for viability.
Payoff Ratio — Avg win ÷ Avg loss. >1.5× preferred.
Ulcer Index — Depth × duration of drawdowns. Lower=smoother equity.
VaR 95% — In worst 5% of orderings, minimum P&L. Positive=always profitable.
